snippet.title: Singleplayer Trailer | Halloween: The Game
snippet.description:
Prepare to unleash hell upon the residents of Haddonfield as the indomitable Michael Myers.

We're thrilled to share our first look at the gripping singleplayer experience for Halloween: The Game and provide more details on what players can expect from the Boogeyman's ruthless journey home. 

https://halloweengame.com/news/unleash-hell-upon-haddonfield

https://halloweengame.com/news/preorder
